Tenant Administration.scope: Manages tenant-specific configurations, menus, items, images, and reservations via a dedicated admin dashboard.

components.name: Tenant
components.responsibility: Represents a distinct organizational unit whose data and resources are isolated within the system.

components.name: TenantConfiguration
components.responsibility: Stores the specific settings and parameters that define how a Tenant operates within the system, including working hours.

components.name: TenantAsset
components.responsibility: Stores tenant-specific assets such as restaurant name, logo, contacts, and menu items.

functions.name: ManageTenantConfiguration
functions.description: Allows the Tenant Administrator to configure the Tenant's settings, including opening hours and general parameters.

functions.name: ManageTenantAssets
functions.description: Allows the Tenant Administrator to manage core tenant assets such as restaurant name, logo, and contact information.

functions.name: ManageMenu
functions.description: Allows the Tenant Administrator to create, update, and manage the restaurant's menu and its constituent Items.

functions.name: ManageMenuItem
functions.description: Allows the Tenant Administrator to manage individual Item details, including descriptions, images, and pricing.

functions.name: ProcessReservation
functions.description: Allows the Tenant Administrator to accept or refuse incoming Reservation requests.

functions.name: ProvideTenantDashboard
functions.description: Serves the dedicated administrative interface for the Tenant Administrator to manage all tenant-specific resources.

interfaces.name: TenantAdminInterface
interfaces.purpose: Provides the boundary for the Tenant Administrator to interact with and manage all tenant-specific data and configurations.

interfaces.name: ReservationManagementInterface
interfaces.purpose: Exposes the functionality for the Tenant Administrator to review and change the status of incoming reservations.

consumes.why: The Tenant Administrator must authenticate using Google credentials.
The aspect manages and persists TenantConfiguration, Menu, Item, and Reservation data.
The aspect manages FoodImage assets associated with Items.
All managed entities (TenantConfiguration, Menu, Item, Reservation) must be isolated per Tenant.
owned by Menu & Item Catalog
owned by Menu & Item Catalog
owned by Menu & Item Catalog
owned by Reservations

Menu & Item Catalog.scope: Handles the structure and display of food items, categories, and menus, including image and description presentation.

components.name: Menu
components.responsibility: Manages the collection of food or drink offerings for a Tenant.

components.name: Category
components.responsibility: Groups menu items and holds organizational data.

components.name: Item
components.responsibility: Represents a specific product offered on the menu.

components.name: FoodImage
components.responsibility: Stores metadata and references for uploaded visual media.

functions.name: BrowseMenu
functions.description: Allows anonymous users to view the menu structure and items for a specific Tenant.

functions.name: ManageMenu
functions.description: Allows authorized Tenant Administrators to create, update, or delete Menu entities.

functions.name: ManageItem
functions.description: Allows authorized users to create, update, or delete Item entities within a Menu.

functions.name: UploadMedia
functions.description: Allows authorized users (Tenant Administrator) to upload and register image files.

functions.name: RetrieveMenuDisplayData
functions.description: Retrieves all necessary data (items, categories, images) to render the menu for a given Tenant.

interfaces.name: MenuDisplayInterface
interfaces.purpose: Provides endpoints for both anonymous browsing and authenticated viewing of the menu structure and item details.

interfaces.name: MenuManagementInterface
interfaces.purpose: Provides CRUD operations for Menu and Item entities, restricted to Tenant Administrators.

interfaces.name: AssetUploadInterface
interfaces.purpose: Handles the secure upload and registration of media assets (FoodImage).

consumes.why: All menu operations must be scoped and isolated per Tenant.
Operations like creating/updating menus require user authorization checks.
Relies on the canonical definitions of Tenant, Item, Category, etc.

Reservations.scope: Manages the process of booking tables, from user submission through to manual administrative confirmation.

components.name: Reservation
components.responsibility: Stores the details of a booking request.

functions.name: SubmitReservation
functions.description: Allows a Google-authenticated User to submit a new Reservation request via the ReservationForm.

functions.name: ConfirmReservation
functions.description: Allows an Admin or TenantAdministrator to manually change the status of a Reservation to confirmed.

functions.name: GenerateReservationAddress
functions.description: Produces a stable address representation for a specific Reservation.

interfaces.name: ReservationSubmissionInterface
interfaces.purpose: Provides the mechanism for authenticated users to submit reservation requests.

interfaces.name: ReservationManagementInterface
interfaces.purpose: Provides endpoints for administrative roles to view and manually update the status of Reservations.

consumes.why: To ensure only authenticated users can access reservation functionality.
To handle data submitted via the ReservationForm.
To manage the state and persistence of the Reservation entity.
To ensure reservations are correctly scoped to a specific Tenant.

User & Access Control.scope: Implements user authentication via Google OAuth and manages access levels for anonymous and authenticated users.

components.name: User
components.responsibility: Represents an individual interacting with the system.

components.name: UserGoogleId
components.responsibility: Stores the unique identifier provided by Google for user authentication.

functions.name: AuthenticateUser
functions.description: Handles the process of authenticating a user via Google OAuth2 flow.

functions.name: CheckUserAccess
functions.description: Determines if a user has sufficient privileges to perform an action, specifically preventing anonymous users from making reservations.

interfaces.name: AuthenticationInterface
interfaces.purpose: Provides endpoints for initiating and completing Google OAuth2 authentication.

interfaces.name: AccessControlInterface
interfaces.purpose: Exposes methods to verify user identity and check permissions before allowing state-changing operations like making a reservation.

consumes.why: The core functionality relies on the 'authentication' tag for managing user identity via Google OAuth.
Access control mechanisms inherently relate to system security.
The requirement specifically addresses the restriction placed on anonymous users.

AI Content Generation.scope: Integrates LLM vision capabilities to generate and manage localized descriptions for food items from images.

components.name: AiDescription
components.responsibility: Stores the generated textual description of a food item.

functions.name: GenerateDescriptionFromImage
functions.description: Generates an AI description for a FoodImage using a vision-capable LLM, respecting the requested Language.

functions.name: StoreDescriptionRecord
functions.description: Persists the generated or manually provided description, along with metadata (item_id, language, approval status, timestamp).

functions.name: ProvideManualDescription
functions.description: Allows manual input of a description for an Item when the LLM service is unavailable.

interfaces.name: DescriptionGenerationInterface
interfaces.purpose: Exposes the capability to request an AI-generated description from an image, specifying the target language.

interfaces.name: DescriptionPersistenceInterface
interfaces.purpose: Provides the mechanism to save or update the description record for an Item.

consumes.why: The core service providing vision-capable AI processing.
To specify the target language (PT or EN) for the generated description.
To record when the description was created or updated.
For persistence and storage operations.
The capability required to process FoodImage input.
owned by Menu & Item Catalog
owned by Menu & Item Catalog

System Infrastructure.scope: Manages cross-cutting concerns like multi-tenancy routing, storage, localization, and responsive design.

components.name: SQLiteInstance
components.responsibility: Manages the isolated database for a single Tenant.

functions.name: ResolveTenantIdentity
functions.description: Determines the Tenant based on the request path prefix.

functions.name: RouteRequest
functions.description: Directs incoming requests to the correct Tenant's SQLiteInstance.

functions.name: ManageTenantData
functions.description: Handles all CRUD operations for a specific Tenant's records within its SQLiteInstance.

functions.name: ServeLocalizedContent
functions.description: Retrieves and serves content based on the current Language setting (PT or EN).

functions.name: RenderResponsiveUI
functions.description: Generates the user interface optimized for various screen sizes (web/mobile).

functions.name: HandleContactSubmission
functions.description: Processes and discards the data submitted via the ContactForm.

functions.name: DisplayMapInterface
functions.description: Renders the geographical map using OpenStreetMap data.

interfaces.name: TenantRoutingInterface
interfaces.purpose: Provides the mechanism to resolve Tenant identity from the request context and route to the correct SQLiteInstance.

interfaces.name: LocalizationInterface
interfaces.purpose: Allows the system to switch and retrieve content based on the active Language.

interfaces.name: AssetStorageInterface
interfaces.purpose: Defines the boundary for storing and retrieving TenantAsset data locally.

interfaces.name: MapDisplayInterface
interfaces.purpose: Exposes the functionality to render the Map interface using external data sources.

consumes.why: To resolve tenant identity using the path prefix and isolate data.
To support switching and displaying content in Portuguese (PT) and English (EN).
To store TenantAsset data locally.
To render the user interface for web and mobile standard layout sizes.
To enforce HTTPS for all public endpoints.
To manage Tenant's corresponding SQLite records.
To define public access points (Endpoints) that require routing and security.
owned by Tenant Administration
owned by Tenant Administration
